_comment: Per-pseudo-channel HBM4 currents at 8000 MT/s with static (all-0s) data, extrapolated from the HBM3E rails (docs/explanation/hbm4-power-prediction.md). Split rails: VDDC 1.05 V (core), VDDQ 0.9 V (DQ pins). Standby is split over all 16 pseudo-channels of the measured HBM2 stack, and the command-driven increments over the 8 pseudo-channels the measurement loops drive: every rail = stack rail / 8 - stack IDD2N / 16. Device power is therefore the sum over all pseudo-channels, each run with its own trace (an idle trace for unused pseudo-channels). Data-pattern model fitted to the HBM2 beat-pattern measurements (relative form). IDD4R/IDD4W are the currents with static data (all knobs 0, the reference); the knobs default to 0.5 (uniform-random data). Override them with --dq-rate/--tsv-rate/--bg-rate.
